sections.heading: Fighting for Rights. Spreading Love. Caring for Each Other.
sections.subheading: Kisumu Sex Workers Alliance (KISWA) — a sex worker-led coalition empowering communities across the Nyanza Region.
sections.background: full-width image of Kisumu/Nyanza community scene, warm and empowering tone

sections.heading: Born from Crisis. Built by Community.
sections.body:
KISWA emerged from the frontlines. In response to brutal killings targeting sex workers in Kisumu and the absence of any organization truly led by sex workers, a group of dedicated peer educators came together with a single, powerful vision: to build something of their own.

Today, KISWA is a coalition of 22 registered sex worker-led groups across Kisumu, Siaya, Homa Bay, Migori, and Kisii — advocating for health, legal rights, and human dignity every single day.

columns.heading: Our Vision
columns.body: A society where sex workers' rights are respected and upheld.

columns.heading: Our Mission
columns.body: To promote sex workers' rights through policy change advocacy, socio-economic empowerment, research, and documentation in Nyanza Region, Kenya.

sections.heading: What We Do
sections.subheading: Five strategic areas drive our work.

cards.title: Sensitization & Awareness
cards.summary: We create awareness among sex workers on their rights — empowering them to recognize and speak against violence.

cards.title: Advocacy & Partnerships
cards.summary: We influence decision-makers to enact policies that recognize and respect sex workers' rights.

cards.title: Access to Health Care
cards.summary: We increase access to health services through community demand, essential commodities, and referral support.

cards.title: Socio-Economic Empowerment
cards.summary: We improve the social and financial welfare of sex workers through skills, knowledge, and opportunity.

cards.title: Organizational Strengthening
cards.summary: We build KISWA's capacity and operational structures to effectively deliver our mission.

sections.heading: Together We Go Further.
sections.body: KISWA is built on love, care, and the unbreakable will of sex workers who refuse to be silenced. Join the movement.
